explanation: The LEFT JOIN on the month minus one year finds the same month of 2024 by its date and keeps every 2025 month, with a missing value where 2024 had no orders. LAG 12 counts twelve rows back, which is a year only when no month is missing: one gap in 2024 shifts every later comparison. The inner join drops the months it cannot match, and LAG with no offset gives the month before, not the year before.
